findings.summary: Every GAMESYNC run (autodeploy on a new title or deploy generation, GAMESYNC START, the purge+redeploy fix loop) copies the staged file back over every favourites file. Favourites return only at the next favourites pass (up to 5 min, and only if the box is still on). Each sync counts those files as written, so a favourites-managed box can never show the documented steady state of '0 file(s) written'. The push does not check whether a GAMESYNC is running on the box.
findings.evidence:
The .123 agent log (box clock is ~2 min behind the host).
- 23:47:35: favourites pass reads the CS vdf at 52 B and uploads 352 B, plus 8 more files.
- 23:47:39 to 23:47:49: GAMESYNC runs, started by autodeploy at host 23:49:39 ('needs a sync: deploy generation 0 -> ...'), and reports '27 file(s) written'.
- 23:52:00: the next pass reads every file back at its staged size: vdf 52 = staged 52, Q3 autoexec 1521 = staged 1521, Q2 3407, RTCW 1423; the four inis are staged +1 B from GAMERES. It re-uploads all of them.
Files: favourites-audit/gamesync_vs_favourites_123_excerpt.txt, agentlog_123_log1.txt, agentlog_123_log.txt, autodeploy_log_copy.txt. Staged sizes from stat on /mnt/retro-share/Files/Games-Library. autodeploy files_written was 20–29 per box.
findings.affected: All managed boxes (.123 .124 .145 .195 .240; .243 for Q2). 9–12 files per box: CounterStrike16\config\serverbrowser.vdf, DeusEx.ini, Quake3/Quake2/RTCW autoexec.cfg, Unreal.ini, UT2004.ini, both UnrealTournament.ini. scripts/gameindex/sync.py push_favorites; scripts/fleet/autodeploy.py; agent GAMESYNC copy.
findings.fix:
Make GAMESYNC and the favourites pass cooperate. Options:
- Have autodeploy (or GAMESYNC completion) trigger `sync.py --ip <box>` immediately after a sync.
- Have push_favorites skip or defer a box whose GAMESYNC STATUS says copying, as autodeploy already does.
- Or do the favourites merge on the agent after the copy, the way GAMERES does.
In every case, keep GAMESYNC's files_written meaningful: do not count a file whose only difference from staged is the managed block.

findings.summary: A directory that does not exist is treated as 'the file is missing, safe to create'. The agent's DIRLIST returns [] with success for a nonexistent path, so read_existing() returns 'missing'. The q3/q2/wolfmp writers (create=True) then MKDIR the whole tree and upload autoexec.cfg. The push also uses the DB index when this pass's refresh failed or is pending, and the DB is keyed by IP. So a stale or reused-IP index can resurrect a purged title as a skeleton.

- Offline reproduction against the real push_favorites: favourites-audit/offline_repro_push_favorites.txt, case B = DIRLIST, then `MKDIR C:\Games\PurgedTitle\baseq3`, then UPLOAD.

Never MKDIR above the title's own subdirectory. Skip the push for a box whose refresh failed this pass, whose index is pending, or whose greeting hostname does not match the DB row. Remove the phantom baseq3 folders once the fix lands.

findings.summary: UT99 favourites flip on every pass on every box, so both UnrealTournament.ini trees are rewritten every 5 minutes. This contradicts the README's 'UT99 … now sit unchanged'. Cause: best_servers() keeps only one of two curated seeds that share a host (85.214.243.170:7777 and :9000). findings.summary: The 'do not write while the game is running' check (BUSY) is bypassed when two title keys share one file. The ioquake3 row is marked BUSY because ioquake3.x86.exe is running, but it is not added to done_paths. The quake3 row for the same folder (quake3.exe, not running) then writes the same baseq3\autoexec.cfg. status.json still lists it as busy / not attempted.
findings.evidence:
- Journal, 00:03 and 00:08 passes on .123, .195 and .240: 'ioquake3 q3 BUSY: ioquake3.x86.exe is running - not attempted' followed by 'quake3 q3 wrote 16 servers (c6113c11…/a3465ca7…)' for the same C:\Games\Quake3-TeamArena. status_json_after_0008_pass.json shows busy=3 for those files.
- Offline reproduction, case A: MKDIR+UPLOAD while ioquake3.x86.exe is running.
- Code: sync.py:444-461. The BUSY check is per exe; done_paths is set only after render.
- Q3 does not rewrite autoexec.cfg on exit, so today's harm is small. The guard and the status are still wrong.
findings.affected: Quake III on every box that indexes both quake3 and ioquake3 in one folder (.123 .124 .145 .195 .240), and any future title whose keys share a file. scripts/gameindex/sync.py push_favorites.
findings.fix: Key the busy check on the target path: if any row that maps to that path has a running exe, mark the path BUSY for every key. Or put BUSY paths into done_paths so later rows skip them.

findings.summary: Question 4: no writer clobbers resolution settings. The Q3 favourites block is appended after `exec fleetres.cfg` but contains only serverN lines. There is one latent risk: files are decoded and re-encoded as ASCII with 'replace', so any non-ASCII byte anywhere in a managed file would silently become '?' on the next write. None were found today. CLAUDE.md's statement that retro-gameindex writes a per-user %APPDATA% autoexec is not supported by the code or the boxes.

- render() raises WouldClobber if a line the writer does not own would be lost (favorites.py:762-820).
- No APPDATA reference anywhere in scripts/gameindex.
- %APPDATA%\Quake3\baseq3 on .123/.145/.195/.240 has no autoexec.cfg (DIRLIST).
- sync.py:306 decodes with ascii/'replace'; sync.py:529 encodes with ascii/'replace'.

- CLAUDE.md ~line 3198.
